sources.title_original: Same Model, Different Harness: CUGA, Hermes, and Deep Agents — When to Pick CUGA?
sources.summary:
A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
A Blog post by IBM Research on Hugging Face
There are nearly 200 agent harnesses to choose from. We gave three of them the same open-weight model and 90 AppWorld tasks, and changing the harness moved task completion from 30% to 81%. For enterprise use, CUGA adds what this benchmark does not test: rules that the harness enforces and deployment inside your own boundary.
Community lists such as awesome-agent-harness and best-of-Agent-Harnesses track nearl
sources.recommend_reason_zh: IBM Research 在 90 个 AppWorld 任务上让 CUGA、Hermes、Deep Agents 共用 GLM-5.3-flash，完成率从 30% 到 81%，SGC 为 20/8/2，说明 harness 需匹配企业多应用 API 工作负载。

en.reason: Holding the model constant across 90 AppWorld tasks, IBM Research's three-harness comparison of CUGA, Hermes and Deep Agents moved completion from 30% to 81%, with CUGA pitched at enterprises needing enforced rules and in-boundary deployment.

You can now delegate coding tasks, guide execution, and review results with GitHub Copilot in JetBrains Air . The integration uses the Agent Client Protocol (ACP) and supports tasks in your JetBrains IDE or in the cloud.
Use Copilot in Air alongside the GitHub Copilot plugin and choose the workflow that works
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Copilot 接入 JetBrains Air，基于 ACP，支持在 IDE 或云端委派编码任务；云端任务运行于 Docker 容器，任务间不保留状态。

en.reason: GitHub Copilot now works in JetBrains Air via the Agent Client Protocol, letting developers delegate coding tasks and review results in the IDE or cloud, where tasks run in Docker containers without retained state.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub Desktop 3.6.10 起，符合条件账户登录可使用短时自动刷新认证令牌，降低泄露令牌可用时长，并自动为 GitHub API 请求和 Git 操作续期；功能正逐步覆盖，暂不含 GitHub Enterprise Server。

sources.title_en: Rewarding defenders with bigger bug bounties

items.recommend_reason_zh: 开源本地大模型工具 Strata 0.2.10 通过动态调整显存与内存分配，让 8GB 显存设备也能启动 Qwen3.8IQ3_S 并维持 128K（131,072 tokens）上下文，官方测试在 DFlash2 模式下生成速度达 63 至 73 tokens/s。

en.title: Run 128K ultra-long context on just 8GB of VRAM! Open-source local LLM tool Strata 0.2.10 released
en.reason: Strata 0.2.10 dynamically adjusts VRAM and RAM allocation so 8GB-VRAM devices can run Qwen3.8IQ3_S at a 128K (131,072-token) context, with official DFlash2-mode tests generating 63–73 tokens/s.

sources.title_original: 人只够盯 5 个对话窗口，DeepSeek 让 AI 自己当"大管家"
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DeepSeek 提出 Super-agent 愿景，指出人最多并行跟 3 到 5 个 Session，方案是隐藏会话并用 Router+Worker 两层架构让前端只面对一个 Agent，还把群聊、邮件、日历、GitHub 评论接入主动触发器。

en.title: People can only keep tabs on 5 chat windows at a time—DeepSeek lets the AI act as chief of staff
en.reason: DeepSeek’s Super-agent vision argues people can track only 3 to 5 Sessions at once, so its Router+Worker design hides sessions behind one Agent and connects group chat, email, calendar and GitHub comments as proactive triggers.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 在首届CMG World Robot Mount Tai Climbing Competition的3.9公里、3100多级台阶赛道上，Unitree A2以全自主模式实际41分41秒完赛、罚2分钟后43分41秒夺冠，B2负重66公斤（含支架74公斤）完成挑战。

sources.title_original: OpenAI hires ex-Army Secretary, gaining bipartisan reach just as midterms loom
sources.summary:
OpenAI hires Dan Driscoll, the former civilian head of the US Army, as "Senior Counselor for National Security Modernization," likely to win government contracts and help shape AI rules for the military and intelligence agencies. Driscoll drove AI projects inside the Army, is a close ally of Vice President JD Vance, and yet maintains good relationships with both parties in Congress - which could prove valuable as midterms approach.

sources.title: Anthropic在Claude Code上打击游戏克隆，此前出现大量AI打造的仿制品 / Anthropic cracks down on game cloning in Claude Code after wave of AI-built knockoffs
sources.title_zh: Anthropic在Claude Code上打击游戏克隆，此前出现大量AI打造的仿制品
sources.title_en: Anthropic cracks down on game cloning in Claude Code after wave of AI-built knockoffs
sources.title_original: Anthropic cracks down on game cloning in Claude Code after wave of AI-built knockoffs
sources.summary:
Anthropic is blocking its coding assistant Claude Code from recreating existing video games.
Anthropic is blocking its coding assistant Claude Code from recreating existing video games.
Anthropic is blocking its coding assistant Claude Code from recreating existing video games. Employee Addy Osmani confirmed on X that two sentences in Claude Code's system prompt for Opus 5.5 now prevent the tool from cloning other people's games. Using Claude to infringe on intellectual property violates the usa
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic在Claude Code系统提示词中加两句话，禁止复刻他人游戏，此前用户借Opus 5.5批量生成Halo等游戏的浏览器移植版。

en.reason: Anthropic added two sentences to Claude Code's system prompt for Opus 5.5, which employee Addy Osmani confirmed on X, to block cloning of existing games after users mass-generated browser ports of titles such as Halo.

stories.title: 华为让客户自行寻找AI芯片内存，实际上等于把采购外包给了黑市 / Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market

sources.title: 华为让客户自行寻找AI芯片内存，实际上等于把采购外包给了黑市 / Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
sources.title_zh: 华为让客户自行寻找AI芯片内存，实际上等于把采购外包给了黑市
sources.title_en: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
sources.title_original: Huawei tells customers to find their own AI chip memory, effectively outsourcing procurement to the black market
sources.summary:
Huawei is telling customers to source the high-performance memory for its AI chips on their own, pushing them onto the black market. Smugglers are exploiting a loophole in U.S. export rules by bundling HBM with low-end processors, shipping them through Hong Kong, and separating the chips on site. Prices for smuggled HBM3E memory have surged to around $4,000 per unit in just one year.
Huawei is telling customers to source the high-performance memory for its AI chips on their own, pushing them ont
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Huawei因中国供应商HBM产能不足、且美国出口规则封锁Samsung和SK Hynix（两家占全球市场超80%），只能让客户自行采购AI芯片内存，走私者借道香港把HBM与低端处理器捆绑运输再拆分，HBM3E单价一年内从几百美元涨到约4000美元。

en.reason: Huawei is telling customers to source HBM for its AI chips themselves, as U.S. rules block Samsung and SK Hynix, over 80% of the market, while smugglers bundle HBM through Hong Kong and HBM3E prices reach about $4,000 a unit.

sources.title_en: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
sources.title_original: Here’s Why You Shouldn’t Use AI to Vote
sources.summary:
From hallucinations to partisan bias, artificial intelligence chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude are not helpful when it comes to Election Day.

From hallucinations to partisan bias, artificial intelligence chatbots like ChatGPT and Claude are not helpful when it comes to Election Day.
As Americans go to the polls today, many will have had their decision abou
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Pew调查显示约50%美国成年人用过AI聊天机器人、8%在中期选举前查候选人和政策，但Forum AI发现主流聊天机器人近40%选举回答含事实错误，Gemini把宾州邮寄选票截止日误说成11月3日而非10月27日。

en.reason: Pew found about 50% of U.S. adults used AI chatbots and 8% checked candidates or policies, while Forum AI found nearly 40% of answers had factual errors, including Gemini listing Pennsylvania’s mail-ballot deadline as Nov. 3 instead of Oct. 27.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Grok Bot配额被曝周末减半，距Elon Musk称其增长最快产品不足两周；他称运行成本相对收入不可持续地高，SpaceX总裁曾提每周80万付费用户。

en.reason: Venkatesh Rao likens AI job-loss fears to mercantilism, where elites treat intelligence as scarce and controllable, arguing AI may raise demand for human thinking, as early capitalism had people work 300 rather than 250 days for tea or sugar.

stories.title: @TapeAIAgent 昨天和 TapeAI 创始人聊了很久，我终于对这个项目想解决的问题，有了一个更清楚的认识。 现在大家谈 AI Agent，往往会想到 Codex、Claude、豆包或者各种自动交易机器人。 它们都很聪明，也能够调用工具、读文件、写代码，甚至操作钱包。 但问题恰恰出在这里： 当一个 AI 的能力越来越强，我们靠什么约束它？ 我们怎么知道它获得了谁的授权？ 它可以动用多少资金？ 哪些地址绝对不能转？ 哪些合约不能…

Ai is the umbrella term for all things artificial intelligence.

What we’re living w is a deep learning model called LLM or Large Language Model. These LLMs learned language by giving it MASSIVE amounts of written and spoken data. From all languages and body movements too.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: The New York Times等多家媒体起诉Brave Software，指控其抓取网站内容训练AI、允许用户绕过付费墙，并向Anthropic、Perplexity等AI公司提供盗取的版权内容。

sources.title_original: AI教AI开车！百度首次披露Apollo World世界模型，让无人驾驶突破“不可能三角”
sources.summary:
百度ApolloWorld世界模型亮相：L4无人车上路前，先在“平行世界”跑完完整行程
百度ApolloWorld世界模型亮相：L4无人车上路前，先在“平行世界”跑完完整行程
本文字数：2168 字
阅读完需：约 7 分钟
Apollo World是百度面向物理AI推出的全模态世界模型，聚焦真实物理规律与因果行为建模，已支撑萝卜快跑百万公里端到端L4无人运营的虚拟训练与安全验证。
世界模型须兼顾“2维能力”（物理保真、交互完备）与“3维标准”（可泛化、可验证、可部署）；以AI智能体替代静态仿真元素，实现交通参与者自主决策与动态交互；技术栈支持从自动驾驶向具身智能等物理AI场景延伸。
适合自动驾驶系统工程师、仿真平台架构师、物理AI研究员阅读。
“世界模型，重点不是渲染的画质是否好看，而是模拟器是否能忠实还原现实物理规律和行为的因果”。11 月 3 日，在深圳举行的百度 AI Day·Apollo 专场上，百度 Apollo 首次披露面向物理 AI 的智能体驱动全模态世界模型 Apollo World，并提出世界模型“2+3”判断标准。目前，该模型已用于萝卜快跑全球化测试与验证，助力无人
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 百度首次披露Apollo World世界模型，称已支撑萝卜快跑超百万公里端到端L4无人运营的虚拟训练与安全验证，并把交通参与者建模为具备决策与交互能力的AI智能体。

en.title: AI teaches AI to drive! Baidu unveils Apollo World model for the first time, enabling self-driving to break the "impossible triangle
en.summary:
Baidu ApolloWorld World Model Unveiled: Before L4 robotaxis hit the road, they complete the full journey in a “parallel world”

Baidu ApolloWorld World Model Unveiled: Before L4 robotaxis hit the road, they complete the full journey in a “parallel world”

Word count: 2,168 | Reading time: about 7 minutes

Apollo World is Baidu's omnimodal world model for physical AI, focused on modeling real physical laws and causal behavior. It has supported the virtual training and safety validation behind Apollo Go's million-kilometer end-to-end L4 driverless operations.

World models must satisfy two capabilities—physical fidelity and complete interactivity—and three standards: generalizable, verifiable, and deployable. AI agents replace static simulation elements, enabling traffic participants to make autonomous decisions and interact dynamically. The tech stack can extend from autonomous driving to embodied intelligence and other physical AI scenarios.

Intended for autonomous-driving system engineers, simulation platform architects, and physical AI researchers.

“The point of a world model is not whether the rendered image looks good, but whether the simulator faithfully reproduces real physical laws and the causality of behavior.” On Nov. 3, at the Baidu AI Day Apollo session in Shenzhen, Baidu Apollo disclosed Apollo World for the first time—an agent-driven omnimodal world model for physical AI—and proposed a “2+3” set of criteria for world models. The model is already being used in Apollo Go's global testing and validation, helping driverless…

sources.summary:
Hans Ku出任首席产品官，推动技术能力支持更大规模影视制作
Hans Ku出任首席产品官，推动技术能力支持更大规模影视制作
本文字数：4675 字
阅读完需：约 15 分钟
Utopai Studios 宣布前迪士尼 AI 高管 Hans Ku 加盟任首席产品官，统筹产品、工程、研究与业务拓展，聚焦长篇影视叙事引擎 PAI 的规模化落地。公司已通过《科尔特斯》《最严肃的屁》等项目验证 AI 与顶尖创作深度协同的能力。
PAI 是面向长篇影视叙事的自研 AI 引擎，非通用模型工具链；Hans Ku 的加盟标志娱乐科技资深经验正式注入 AI 原生影视生产体系；原创片单推进与制作现场技术扎根构成核心竞争力。
适合 AI 架构师、影视技术负责人、AIGC 产品负责人阅读。
2026 年 11 月 2 日，被美国权威媒体《综艺》（Variety）评价为"全球最大独立 AI 原生影视公司"的 Utopai Studios 宣布前迪士尼 AI 高管 Hans Ku 正式加盟，出任首席产品官，向联合创始人兼首席执行官 Cecilia Shen 汇报。他将统筹产品、工程、研究及业务拓展，推动技术能力
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 2026年11月2日，前迪士尼AI与工程副总裁Hans Ku出任Utopai Studios首席产品官，统筹产品、工程、研究与业务拓展，推动长篇影视叙事引擎PAI规模化落地。

Utopai Studios has announced that former Disney AI executive Hans Ku is joining as Chief Product Officer, overseeing product, engineering, research and business development, with a focus on scaling its long-form film and TV storytelling engine PAI. The company says projects including Cortés and The Most Serious Fart have proven its ability to deeply integrate AI with top-tier creative talent.

PAI is a proprietary AI engine built for long-form film and TV storytelling, not a general-purpose model toolchain. Hans Ku's appointment marks the formal arrival of deep entertainment-tech experience in an AI-native film and TV production system. Advancing an original slate and rooting technology in production are its core competitive strengths.

Intended for AI architects, film and TV technology leads, and AIGC product leads.

On November 2, 2026, Utopai Studios—called the world's largest independent AI-native film and TV company by Variety—announced that former Disney AI executive Hans Ku has officially joined as Chief Product Officer, reporting to co-founder and CEO Cecilia Shen. He will oversee product, engineering, research and business development, driving technical capabilities to support larger-scale film and TV production...
en.reason: Former Disney AI and engineering vice president Hans Ku became chief product officer of Utopai Studios on November 2, 2026, overseeing product, engineering, research and business development to scale its PAI long-form narrative engine.

stories.title: AI 改变的是数据接口，而不是查询引擎

sources.title: AI 改变的是数据接口，而不是查询引擎
sources.title_zh: AI 改变的是数据接口，而不是查询引擎
sources.title_original: AI 改变的是数据接口，而不是查询引擎
sources.summary:
本文介绍了一个灾难恢复分析工作流：由 AI 智能体生成带约束的 SQL 或 Python 代码，DuckDB 基于 Parquet 文件计算可复现的事实数据，再由智能体解读结果。
本文介绍了一个灾难恢复分析工作流：由 AI 智能体生成带约束的 SQL 或 Python 代码，DuckDB 基于 Parquet 文件计算可复现的事实数据，再由智能体解读结果。
本文字数：6478 字
阅读完需：约 21 分钟
AI智能体在运维分析中嵌入轻量查询引擎（如DuckDB），实现端到端结构化报告生成，无需依赖传统湖仓架构。核心在于将确定性计算（指标聚合）与概率性推理（故障归因）解耦，按实际需求选择嵌入式引擎或托管湖仓。
关键观点：嵌入式引擎适用于低延迟、确定性聚合+小规模推理场景；湖仓仍必要于跨团队共享、高并发SQL、长期治理与合规审计；判断依据包括数据时效性、协作广度、计算确定性及治理要求。
适合SRE工程师、数据平台架构师、AI工程化负责人阅读。
AI 智能体如今可以生成分析代码、从对象存储读取文件，并将运维数据转为结构化报告。这是否意味着数据湖、湖仓一体和 SQL 引擎已经过时？我们在对一场
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以30秒粒度容灾演练为例，说明AI智能体只生成受约束SQL/Python、由DuckDB基于Parquet计算可复现事实，并给出四个判断依据，决定何时用嵌入式引擎、何时仍需托管湖仓。

en.title: AI changes the data interface, not the query engine
en.summary:
This article walks through a disaster recovery analysis workflow: an AI agent generates constrained SQL or Python code, DuckDB computes reproducible facts from Parquet files, and the agent then interprets the results.

Word count: 6,478 words
Reading time: about 21 minutes

AI agents can embed lightweight query engines such as DuckDB into operations analysis to produce end-to-end structured reports without relying on a traditional lakehouse architecture. The key is decoupling deterministic computation (metric aggregation) from probabilistic reasoning (fault attribution), then choosing an embedded engine or a managed lakehouse based on actual needs.

Key points: embedded engines suit low-latency, deterministic aggregation plus small-scale reasoning; lakehouses remain necessary for cross-team sharing, high-concurrency SQL, long-term governance, and compliance audits. The decision criteria include data freshness, collaboration breadth, computational determinism, and governance requirements.

Intended for SRE engineers, data platform architects, and AI engineering leads.

AI agents can now generate analysis code, read files from object storage, and turn operational data into structured reports. Does this mean data lakes, lakehouses, and SQL engines are obsolete? In our...
en.reason: Using a 30-second-granularity disaster recovery drill, the workflow has AI agents generate constrained SQL or Python while DuckDB computes reproducible facts from Parquet files, and gives four criteria for choosing an embedded engine versus a managed lakehouse.

Key points: embedded engines suit low-latency, deterministic aggregation plus small-scale reasoning; lakehouses remain necessary for cross-team sharing, high-concurrency SQL, long-term governance, and compliance audits. The decision criteria include data freshness, collaboration breadth, computational determinism, and governance requirements.

Intended for SRE engineers, data platform architects, and AI engineering leads.

stories.title: 【25年前的“智能代理”梦想，今天换了一种方式实现】 11月2日，《麻省理工科技评论》刊发长文《智能体网络已经到来》（https://t.co/rVUmupywZn）：如今的AI助手能帮人整理邮件、比价、订餐厅和机票，有的还被授权访问邮箱；网站也开始同时为“人”和“AI代理”提供内容。文章引用皮尤研究中心去年的一项研究称，页面出现AI摘要时，人们点进网站的概率约低40%，所以网络会更开放，还是更集中在少数大平台手里，现在没有定论。文中…

en.title:
The "intelligent agent" dream from 25 years ago is coming true today — just in a different way

On November 2, MIT Technology Review published a long feature, The Agent Web Has Arrived (https://t.co/rVUmupywZn): today's AI assistants can sort email, compare prices, book restaurant tables and flights, and some are even authorized to access inboxes; websites are also starting to serve content to both humans and AI agents.
en.reason: AI assistants can now sort email, compare prices and book restaurants and flights—some are granted email access—as MIT Technology Review’s November 2 article cites Pew research that AI summaries cut site click-throughs by about 40%.

stories.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052

sources.title: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052
sources.title_zh: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052
sources.title_original: AI音乐周刊 W.A 052
sources.summary: 本周AI音乐周刊汇集了近期行业版权新规、商业变动与产品更新。韩国音著协探索AI音乐确权信托，Spotify计划推出合规AI翻唱工具，MiniMax收缩国内音乐云端业务。Suno MCP、ElevenLabs音效新模型、NI合成器等新品上线。还有6篇前沿论文，覆盖音频合成、乐谱建模等方向，适合音乐创作者、音频开发者快速掌握行业动态与落地工具。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 韩国音著协（KOMCA）10月27日在国会开研讨会，针对AI音乐版权信托标准空白，要求申报算法介入程度并留存DAW分轨，拟用声学检测与专家复核筛查纯算法音轨。

en.title: AI Music Weekly W.A 052
en.summary: This week's AI Music Weekly rounds up recent copyright rules, business shifts and product updates. Korea's Music Copyright Association is exploring a rights-ownership trust for AI music, Spotify plans to launch a compliant AI cover tool, and MiniMax is scaling back its domestic music cloud business. New releases include Suno MCP, a new ElevenLabs sound-effects model and an NI synthesizer. There are also six cutting-edge papers covering audio synthesis, music-score modeling and more — a quick way for music creators and audio developers to catch up on industry trends and practical tools.
en.reason: KOMCA’s 27 October forum targets AI music copyright trust gaps with algorithm-involvement declarations, DAW stems and acoustic screening, alongside Spotify’s compliance AI-cover plans, MiniMax’s China cloud retreat and six frontier papers.

stories.title: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来

sources.title: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.title_zh: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.title_original: DeepSeek这次，想把你从AI的监工岗位上解放出来
sources.summary: 老金这篇文章把 Super-agent 的机制讲得很直白：Router 像调度员，记住任务关系并分派；Worker 在各自会话里并行执行，耗时操作转后台，独立检查者盯进度和跑偏。它用更多计算换更短、更稳的等待，但公开原型仍偏实验，需配 Harness、独立账号和隔离环境，主动任务先观察、代码先人工合并。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: DeepSeek产品部公布Super-agent设计探索，演示Agent从群聊接改字体需求、在同一个PR追加字号设置，经GitHub审查折叠设置项后回群通知合并。

en.title: This time, DeepSeek wants to free you from the job of supervising AI
en.summary: Lao Jin’s article lays out the Super-agent mechanism plainly: the Router acts as a dispatcher, remembering task relationships and assigning work; Workers execute in parallel in their own sessions, time-consuming operations get moved to the background, and independent checkers monitor progress and drift. It trades more compute for shorter, steadier waits, but the public prototype is still experimental and requires a Harness, separate accounts, and isolated environments. Proactive tasks should be observed first, and code should be merged manually first.
en.reason: DeepSeek’s Super-agent design exploration pairs a Router that dispatches tasks with parallel Workers and an independent checker, demoing an agent that adds a font-size setting to the same PR and reports the merge back to group chat.

sources.title_en: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.title_original: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Terence Tao博客的客座文章以“无穷多个素数在有人证明前已存在”为例，讨论AI时代数学应视为发现还是发明，以及数学家如何理解独立于个人的数学秩序。

en.reason: Infinitely many primes existed before anyone proved it, a fact Karthik C. S., Amit Sahai and Jie Xue use on Terence Tao’s blog to ask whether AI-era mathematics is discovery or invention and how mathematicians grasp impersonal order.

sources.title: AI时代无我数学的讨论
sources.title_zh: AI时代无我数学的讨论
sources.title_en: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.title_original: Egoless Mathematics in the AI Era
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 文章以“喜欢做、擅长做、有人付费”的三圈Venn图剖析AI冲击：数学证明三圈皆受威胁，数学家或转向解释结果与教学，software engineering则看目标是否“make something work”。

en.reason: A Venn diagram of what you like, are good at, and get paid for frames AI's threat to mathematicians seeking never-before-proven results, pushing them toward explaining results and teaching, while software engineering hinges on making something work.

sources.title_original: 10.26—11.1｜本周精选 AI 论文
sources.summary: 这一周的精选 AI论文有个很明显的信号：AI 系统开始从“把更强模型塞进更多 Agent”，转向让检索、验证、记忆和模型协作各自做更确定的事。想把 Agent 做稳的人，这批研究比单纯看模型榜单更有参考价值。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: 本期精选涵盖DecisionRAG与Unified Training：前者用决策模型逐层检索，在MultiDoc2Dial上R@1较密集检索加8B重排序器高13.8点，单次查询耗时0.7至1.8秒；后者把预训练到强化学习置于单一似然算法下。

en.title: 10.26–11.1 | This Week's Best AI Papers
en.summary: This week's curated AI papers send a clear signal: AI systems are moving away from "stuffing stronger models into more Agents" and toward making retrieval, verification, memory, and model collaboration each do more deterministic work. For anyone trying to build Agents that hold up, these studies are more useful than simply scanning model leaderboards.
en.reason: DecisionRAG's decision-model layered retrieval beats dense retrieval plus an 8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 points on MultiDoc2Dial at 0.7–1.8 seconds per query, while Unified Training unifies pretraining through RL under one likelihood algorithm in this week's selected AI papers.

en.reason: DecisionRAG's decision-model layered retrieval beats dense retrieval plus an 8B reranker by 13.8 R@1 points on MultiDoc2Dial at 0.7–1.8 seconds per query, while Unified Training unifies pretraining through RL under one likelihood algorithm in this week's selected AI papers.

en.title: ChatGPT's December quota merge: will we have to draft our prompts before asking?
en.summary: OpenAI's new December quota rules have rattled plenty of heavy users: advanced ChatGPT conversations and Codex will share a single Token pool, with only Instant quick chats exempt from the quota. The author's firsthand experience offers an early look at how subscription costs will shift, and decodes billing logic that mirrors Claude's — so you won't find your hands tied later when you want to use strong reasoning models.
en.reason: From December, OpenAI will make Plus, Pro and Business users share one Token pool across ChatGPT advanced conversations and Codex, with Instant chats exempt, and a hands-on account shows how subscription costs and strong-reasoning access change.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 在Dubai的UiPath FUSION上，UiPath CEO Daniel Dines说教育体系仍沿用约200年前工业革命模式，企业把更多工作交给AI后，人必须引导AI并为AI行为担责，且不要用AI做普通软件能可靠完成的事。

en.reason: At UiPath FUSION in Dubai, CEO Daniel Dines argued that as companies hand more work to AI, people must steer it and answer for its actions, while schools still follow a roughly 200-year-old industrial model.
